items.title: Mirror download has an unexpected checksum
items.body: The repository index advertises a new digest, but an existing archive with the same filename still contains the older bytes. Rebuilding the index did not replace that remote object.

comments.body: The destination name is unchanged. Compare the stored object's SHA-256 before adding it to the package index.

items.title: Verify existing archive bytes before index publication
items.body: Fixes #40. Refuse to publish a package index when an already-present filename has bytes that differ from the incoming archive. This does not automatically repair old objects.

items.title: Version-bound advisory metadata
items.body: Publish vulnerability findings beside each package version so a new advisory can be distributed without rebuilding the application. Missing metadata means unknown, not clean.

items.title: Move package builds to disposable CI workers
items.body: Build contributions in temporary workers and publish artifacts after merge. Revisit the transport proposal in #50 against the new publishing path.

items.title: Download fails when the mirror connection times out
items.body: A slow network connection interrupted the transfer. This report does not establish that the stored archive bytes are wrong.
